title: How Costco Makes Money
description:
Costco sold two hundred and seventy billion dollars of groceries, tyres, televisions and chicken last year, and made about five billion from all of it. It collected five point three billion in membership fees, and kept nearly all of that. The cards made more profit than the shopping did.

This is how warehouse clubs actually make money, and why the shop floor is the part that never has to pay for itself.
